# KILID public aggregate-table fixtures

Captured with ordinary verified-HTTPS GETs on 2026-11-17 from
https://kilid.com/house-prices and its public links. File names identify the
selected page; `region5-*` means `tehran-region5`, `moradabad` means
`tehran-region5-moradabad`, and `region1` means `tehran-region1`.
`toman-12` uses the default URL; other windows/denominations use the site's
advertised `months=6|36` and `denom=usd|gold` links.

Only the canonical URL, minimal JSON-LD identity/metadata, selected controls,
methodology text and aggregate numerical tables are retained. Styling, SVG
paths, application scripts, advertisements, individual listings and contact
information are removed. These are source-contract test excerpts, not a data
redistribution product or an assertion of a KILID data license. Attribution:
KILID / کلان داده شهر فناوران. See `docs/kilid.md` for access/licensing findings.

The captured USD/gold three-year tables have 35 rows through 1405-07; the toman
table has 36 through 1405-08. Future-dated metadata, differing chart/statistic
values, mixed geographic levels and modeled/imputed values are intentionally
preserved. Shahriar's sparse chart is a rejection fixture, not evidence of a
complete observed history. No valid-empty history contract was observed.
